entities.summary: Rai Sport 2 was an Italian sports TV channel, launched on 18 May 2010 by the State-owned RAI television network. It broadcast Italian and international sports events in Italy on DTT channel 58 on Mux Rai 2. It was also available on Sky Italia and on IPTV. The channel was discontinued in February 2017 as RAI consolidated their sports under one network channel combining RAI Sports 1 and RAI Sports 2 into the now RAI Sports + HD.
